cases.name: Crystal Dawn Kiser
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was a graduate of Sissonville High School and Mountaineer Beauty College and was a Cosmetologist. She worked part time at the Jackson County Animal Shelter. She was an avid animal lover and attended the Grace Community Church."
cases.narrative: He buried her in a shallow grave in Jackson County.
